title: Saw It Through - How to Earn & Missable Status
description: Saw It Through trophy in Phantom Blade Zero - how to earn it, whether it is missable, and how the PS5 and Steam lists differ.
keyword: Saw It Through phantom blade zero trophy

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: A paired fight - one fast, one heavy. Fighting both inside the same cone is what ends runs, so separate them first.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: Trophy 15 of 36 on the list - before it The White Shadow · after it Collector's Notes. It is not missable, so a missed run can be finished later without a restart. The full list with rarity is on the trophy list; the Platinum route and the order to do things in are on the trophy guide.
